Press the keys [c red]ESDF[c white] to move your character.\n\nMove the [c red]mouse[c white] to look around.
To open the door, press [c red]Spacebar[c white] while facing it.
Press [c red]Spacebar[c white] to pick up items.\n\nPress [c red]C[c white] to open your inventory.
Medkits are automatically used when touched.\n\nA portion of your health is slowly restored when outside of combat.
Press [c red]Mouse button 4[c white] to attack with your melee weapon.
Press [c red]Spacebar[c white] to activate the switch.

Press [c red]Left-click[c white] to shoot your gun.
Hold [c red]Right-click[c white] to aim and reduce recoil at the cost of movement speed.

When the reticle turns [c yellow]yellow[c white], critical hit chance is doubled.
Keys are kept until the end of the level.\n\nHold [c red]A[c white] to sprint back.
Attack the crate to open it.
Press [c red]W[c white] to switch weapons.
Hold [c red]Tab[c white] to view the map.\n\nYellow icons are keys.
While your inventory is open, [c red]Left-click[c white] and [c red]drag[c white] the item to move it into your inventory.
Press [c red]V[c white] to turn your flashlight on.
Kill the boss to get the final key!
Increasing your gun handling stat reduces the recoil of your guns.
Skill points can be spent to increase various attributes when you level up. Try increasing [c red]Fortitude[c white] if you are having problems staying alive.
Holding [c red]Alt[c white] will show additional information on the inventory screen.
Mods can be used to enhance your gear.\n\nOpen your inventory and try adding a mod to one of your weapons or armor.
The [c red]level[c white] of an item determines the amount of damage or defense it has. Item [c red]quality[c white] is random and affects all of its stats.
The Bolt-Action Rifle can be used to pick off enemies from a distance. Try holding [c red]right-click[c white] to pan the camera around.
Like the Sawed-off Shotgun, the [c red]Crossbow[c white] shoots all of its loaded ammunition when fired.\n\nTry increasing its bolt capacity with mods.
